turns.customer: We're new! Can we use the First Stay & Play offer for 3 nights in a luxury suite for our pup Ziggy, Jan 26 to 29 2027?
blocks:
The offer **may be an option**, since it’s for new clients, but Happy Tails says participation can vary by resort and is subject to availability. Its published terms describe **one night at the Standard room rate**—with any suite upgrade paid—and a **free group-play evaluation only** the next day; it doesn’t promise three free daycare days. Whether it can be applied to your three-night Luxury stay is not specified, so Happy Tails staff can clarify at **(512) 764-6150**.

For **Jan 26–29, 2027 (3 nights)**, the listed Luxury Suite estimate is **$270** (3 × $90 per day). The resort bills by the day, and staff confirm the final total. Peak or seasonal pricing may apply, but the published information doesn’t say whether these dates qualify.
